## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** The whole domain of the three in-scope extended policies and their base policies — including untriggered branches (earlier-review continuation tier, IU-only and both-IU-and-TT full-tier rows, replaced-returns resumption tier, aid-and-attendance tiers, two-parent tiers) and the retired surface — is carried at the same strength; each prerequisite sentence stands verbatim on the blocked side only, in its declared state form. First revision.

Policy-side notes (not KB verdicts):
1. Base `comp_evt_rating_change` — "Past-due benefits on a suspended award are computed but released only when the award resumes." — orders the TT release after the resumption, while `prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness` treats the two prerequisites as commuting. The KB renders the base sentence as the source has it (`rating_decisions_and_effective_dates_b107ecce` §5); figures are order-invariant.
2. The restoration's "past-due release" in what stands paid covers the resumption release in the source compute (`rr_paid` sums every `comp_retro_payment`); the source rule and the KB use the same words, and the visible withholding document supports that reading. No KB defect.
3. Spans of the resumption, TT and restoration releases are not stated by the source rules; they are derived (GT traces derive them as the blind audit did).
